about: Demo mood library for tools/music.py (library mode). Only the manifest is in git: `tools/nx music <episode> fetch` (or `python3 tools/music.py fetch`) downloads the files into ~/.cache/vibe-animator/music/ and checks each sha256. All tracks: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0; the credit lines below must go in the video description (music.py writes them to <episode>/music/CREDITS.txt). See THIRD_PARTY.md.
